verdict.rationale: Smithery documents scoped "service tokens" that restrict an agent's access to specific connections/metadata (e.g., only tools where userId matches) rather than exposing the full API key, directly matching least-privilege credential issuance for agents [smithery-docs-6][smithery-docs-7]. This is reinforced by namespace-scoped API keys for team/workspace isolation [smithery-docs-15][smithery-docs-26] and secure encrypted credential storage [smithery-docs-3]. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of token scoping enforcement, and no evidence of granular per-tool or per-action permission scoping beyond the userId/connection example.
